tickets.why: Own 55.0% vs 52.8% breakeven. Only side on the Week 12 board at Rule A. Why now: Sam Darnold (quad, cracked ribs) is questionable and Macdonald wants to see Wednesday's practice before confirming the start; Seattle's line is hurting (Nelson doubtful, Cross and Lucas questionable; search, UNVERIFIED). tickets.kill_switch: Before placing: 46 at -115 or better is fine. 45.5 or lower, or 46.5 worse than -120: skip, the $10 goes back to Sunday's pool. Darnold out or Purdy out: keep (a backup QB helps the Under). Weather is not a factor at Levi's. If already placed, keep.
